tarot/draws/selection.yaml.public: Render the named card, its position, localized tone and the localized reflection. Attach the shared reflection footer. Restrict interpretation to drawn cards. Stored readings reopen using their saved bindings and text version.
replay: spread id and ordered position IDs
tarot/draws/selection.yaml.reversals: Independent fair orientation when enabled, otherwise upright. Preserve the stored draw on reopen.
tarot/draws/selection.yaml.seed: Generate 32 random bytes with the OS CSPRNG per new reading. Admin replay takes the same 64 hex characters. Store the seed only with the access-controlled replay record.
tarot/draws/selection.yaml.shuffle: Unbiased Fisher–Yates using a cryptographic uniform integer in [0,i] for each descending index. Optional cut rotates the permutation. Choose unique positions without replacement.
tarot/draws/selection.yaml.slots: Take the first N indices unless the user explicitly picks N distinct zero-based indices from the cut deck in slot order. Orientation stream in slot order: 0 upright, 1 reversed, using uniform(2); disabled always yields upright.
tarot/draws/selection.yaml.stream: For each purpose (shuffle or orientation), HMAC-SHA256 keyed by the seed. Message = ASCII bhava360-tarot-v1/ + purpose + slash + unsigned 64-bit big-endian counter starting at zero. Consume each digest as eight consecutive unsigned 32-bit big-endian words.
tarot/draws/selection.yaml.uniform: For bound n, discard words >= 2^32 - (2^32 mod n); accept word mod n. Shuffle from i=77 down to 1 swapping i with uniform(i+1). Rotate the shuffled deck left by cut positions (0 through 77).

method: Keep draw order. Count Majors and reversals independently over all cards. At least half marks a theme; smaller shares add context.
Find modal minor suit and element independently. Preserve all ties; an all-Major draw has no suit. Repeated pip ranks require two distinct cards.
Bind each adjacent pair in draw order. Use the first applicable emphasized position, then the next for a practical reflection. No card supplies a prediction.
